title: kt-null-graph-controls: code and run files for "Do log-built concept graphs help KC-level learner models? Entry-point null graphs, a positive control and decision-level tests"
description:
Code, run files and analysis scripts for the manuscript "Do log-built concept graphs help KC-level learner models? Entry-point null graphs, a positive control and decision-level tests" (H. B. Truong, under revision for User Modeling and User-Adapted Interaction).

The study fixes KC-level tracers and measures a concept graph against an empty-graph control that keeps every other parameter, a ladder of null graphs, fixed random codes, capacity controls and seed ensembles on ten public corpora, at five entry points (embedding refinement, attention bias, state channel, the training loss of PDKT and the propagation of GKT), with a replication on two held-out corpora under a pre-specified plan, an item-level Q-matrix ladder, authored KC structures (Junyi, DBE-KT22, XES3G5M KC routes), and simulated worlds with a known prerequisite graph used as a positive control and for next-KC decisions with prerequisite gating. Every run file, analysis output and script behind the tables and figures of the manuscript and its Online Resources is under kt/; unit tests in tests/.

Version 7.0.0 adds the runs and analyses of the third UMUAI version (kt/src/r21_*.py, kt/runs_r21_sim, kt/runs_r21, kt/results_r21): 143 training runs (the full null-graph ladder on the true graph of two simulated worlds at 5%, 10% and 25% of the training learners; the XES3G5M KC routes and their rewiring), decisions in the simulated worlds with a gate on the candidate set, a KC-rate decision rule, set-level agreement, sensitivity to the target, seed ensembles, the minimum detectable effect of every comparison and the sensitivity of the graph construction to its threshold. Earlier content (releases 2.0.0 to 6.0.0) is unchanged.
